commands.name: list-packages
commands.summary: List every opam package alphabetically by name, with latest version and description. The full list comes back in one response; filter it yourself to search.

commands.name: list-recent-packages
commands.summary: List opam packages sorted by their most recent publish date, newest first, with latest version and description.

commands.name: get-package
commands.summary: Get details of the latest version of an opam package: synopsis, description, author, license and latest version.

commands.name: list-package-versions
commands.summary: List all published versions of an opam package, with links to each version's detail page.

commands.name: get-package-version
commands.summary: Get details of a specific version of an opam package: synopsis, description, author, license, source URL/checksums and other metadata.

commands.name: get-package-dependencies
commands.summary: List the dependency formula entries (dependencies, optional deps and conflicts) of a specific opam package version, with version constraints.

commands.name: list-package-dependents
commands.summary: List the packages that require a given opam package (reverse dependencies, 'Required by'), with their version constraints.
